Question Choices: Write the composition (f circle g)(x) in nested-function notation.
Hints: Apply g first.|Then use its output as the input of f.
Solution: Composition works inside out: (f circle g)(x)=f(g(x)), so g acts first. Reversing the order can change the result; for f(x)=2x+1 and g(x)=x^2, the two orders at 3 give 19 and 49. The composition is f(g(x)).
